name: Ban Gioc Waterfall
kicker: Border cascade on the Quay Son
summary: Give Ban Gioc the morning, from the Vietnam bank of the Quay Son, and sleep in Dam Thuy or in the city the night before. The cascade is more than 80 km east of town. Skip a late arrival from the end of November to the beginning of April, when the water is very low and the board asks you to come between 10:30 and 15:30.
timeNeeded: The same day as the cave and the pagoda
getThere: More than 80 km east of Cao Bang city. Drive minutes are check on arrival.
bestMonths: June to September for more water; low water from late November to early April
heroCaption: The cascade, the Quay Son, and the limestone at Ban Gioc

notice.title: Low water has a clock
notice.body: From the end of November to the beginning of April the management board says the water is very low and asks you to come between 10:30 and 15:30. A late arrival in those months wastes the day.

body: Stand on the Vietnam bank and look across the width of the cascade. A bamboo raft toward the foot is the optional ride. The geopark also names a cross-border scenic route at Ban Gioc–Detian. Whether a visitor may cross is check on arrival. This page does not state a visa rule.

The 10 December 2024 timing notice says the fall is about 300 m wide and 35 m high, in three tiers. Vietnam Tourism says the main fall is over 30 m. An indexed provincial note said about 208 m wide and was not reloaded, so that figure stays off the page. Pages also repeat a “fourth largest” ranking. Treat it as a slogan, not a measurement.

Pair the falls with Nguom Ngao and the pagoda. Do not add Phia Oac, and do not add Pac Bo. Those roads leave town the other way. The gate fee is check on arrival. No current tariff was on UNESCO, the geopark pages, Vietnam Tourism, or the timing notice.

figures.caption: A bamboo raft on the river in front of the cascade
figures.alt: A covered bamboo raft on the Quay Son with Ban Gioc waterfall and limestone behind it

gettingThere: Ban Gioc is in Dam Thuy, on the eastern geopark road. The December 2024 notice still says Trung Khanh, more than 80 km from the city centre. The road out of town is National Highway 3, then the valley. Drive minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Cao Bang city
legs.body: East by car or motorbike, more than 80 km. No published minute count was on the pages read. A local bus to the falls is check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hanoi
legs.body: Vietnam Tourism puts the falls about 340 km north of Hanoi by paved national highway. The city is the usual overnight break. Do not treat the falls as a day return from the capital.

hours: Check on arrival. In the low-water months the management board asks visitors to come between 10:30 and 15:30.
closed: No weekly closing day was on the timing notice. Check the board on arrival.
admissionNote: Check on arrival. UNESCO, the geopark pages, Vietnam Tourism, and Official Letter 424/TB-BQLKDLTBG of 10 December 2024 do not print a current tariff. A raft, if you take one, is separate from any gate. No raft price was on those pages.
